name: mujoco_local_scan
description: Saved-map navigation qualification for the SCAN local-planner backend.

claims: the nav RunPlan explicitly selects the SCAN local-planner backend
MuJoCo truth odometry isolates local planning and tracking from SLAM error
the simulated MuJoCo robot base reaches at least 0.5 m/s planar speed during the long-range run
SCAN consumes the complete Mapd local collision snapshot and the global route shape
the native SCAN trajectory is followed through the common Executor and Driver chain
terminal exact Driver stop acknowledgement, zero command, authority clear, and owned-process cleanup
excluded_claims: promotion of SCAN to the default local-planner backend
